incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired for service=runtime-canary region=eu-west-1
incident-bot: rule=canary-5xx-rate threshold=5% current=12.3% window=5m
pagerduty-bot: Incident PDR-4832 created and notified @Maya, @Simon
Maya: acking and taking lead, on-call now. digging into canary pods + logs :mag:
Maya: checking pod restarts and nginx 5xx traces
Simon: pinging, available to help. do we want to pause rollout? @Alex
Alex: holding new traffic to canary via gateway toggle. flipping traffic to stable in 30s
Maya: running quick query — recent spike aligns with canary image tag v2.14.2
Maya: logs (tail):
```
2026-03-14T22:11:05Z runtime ERROR request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream_timeout
2026-03-14T22:11:07Z runtime ERROR request_id=def456 kvcache miss -> fallback slow
```

Jade: support is seeing about 14 user-facing errors (enterprise customers) since 22:09 UTC, opening tickets
Simon: will attempt rollback of canary. plan: rollback canary replicaset to v2.13.9 and divert traffic
Simon: command I'm running:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/runtime-canary --to-revision=42
kubectl -n inference patch svc gateway -p '{"spec":{"traffic":{"canary":0}}}'
```
Maya: initiating autoscale bump for stable to absorb traffic while rollback finishes
pagerduty-bot: PDR-4832 acknowledged by Maya
incident-bot: escalation policy step 2 in 5m if not resolved
Alex: monitoring metrics dashboard — p95 dropping after traffic switch. good sign :thumbsup:
Maya: rollback completed @22:17 UTC. confirming 5xx rate back to 0.8% over 5m
Jade: customer impact — 16 total errors, 2 SEV2 tickets opened, both notified
Maya: marking incident as mitigated. will keep route open for 30m for observations. creating follow-up INF-1234 postmortem
Simon: leaving notes in incident channel and handing back to oncall rotation. good job team :heart:
Maya: closing the PD incident and sending summary to #postmortems
pagerduty-bot: Incident PDR-4832 resolved by Maya
